summative_rubric.title: Bug Busters — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: solve problems and create computational representations of mathematical situations by writing and executing code, including code that involves sequential, concurrent, and repeating events

levels.descriptor: Cannot write 2-lane code with concurrent events.
Writes 2-lane code with prompts and supports.
Writes complete 2-lane code with concurrent and repeating events.
Writes 2-lane code with multiple lanes; predicts all outcomes.

rows.expectation_text: read and alter existing code, including code that involves sequential, concurrent, and repeating events, and describe how changes to the code affect the outcomes

levels.descriptor: Cannot find bugs or alter code.
Finds bugs with prompts and supports.
Traces, finds bugs, alters to fix, verifies.
Identifies bug type; predicts cascading fix effects.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to combined evidence from Lesson 5 capstone.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 2 rows.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Bug Buster Project
administration_steps: Circulate; prompt children with no-bug-plant trap.
Score: code + bug + partner fix = L3; plus reflection = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent 2-lane code (out of 3) + intentional bug (out of 2) + partner fix verified (out of 3) + reflection (out of 2) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C3.1: Code includes 2 lanes and concurrent events.
